dissipation or restraint of trapped and residual energy

facts.site: Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop
facts.title: positive isolation verification failure on P-9502

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 1 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control PRESSURE_EQUIPMENT_INSPECTION: the in-service inspection of pressure equipment was never verified as effective, and the learning team review classified this as an absent or failed defence.
Control STEAM_SYSTEM_WARM_THROUGH: the controlled draining, venting and warm-through of steam systems was not in place, and the learning team review classified this as an absent or failed defence.

Control STORED_ENERGY_DISSIPATION: the dissipation or restraint of trapped and residual energy was in place but did not perform, and the learning team review classified this as an organisational factor.

recommendations: Restore the in-service inspection of pressure equipment on P-9502 and M-9502 and record the assurance activity before this task is next authorised.
Restore the controlled draining, venting and warm-through of steam systems on P-9502 and M-9502 and record the assurance activity before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in verifying pressure relief and protection, specifically proving overpressure protection is in service. P-9502 (dewatering pumps) is in service for pit dewatering. The task proceeded during cleaning and preparation while the in-service inspection of pressure equipment was never verified as effective. The pressure energy involved is held as hydraulic accumulator, and the recorded presentation was jet release, stored-energy discharge, rupture.
response.summary: On 30 July 2022 an incident occurred on P-9502 and M-9502 at Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop during cleaning and preparation, releasing pressure energy held as hydraulic accumulator.
